assertion_analysis.assertions: release count; receipt singleton; outcome; attempt; run/batch; unrelated-source receipt absence and token; selected token cleared; append-before-clear order
assertion_analysis.fails_when: Removing the release append loses the singleton receipt and the recorded mutation reddens both variants; changing outcome, count, attempt, metadata, release ownership filtering or statement order contradicts the independent seeded source state or stored receipt.

assertion_analysis.assertions: missing-token zero write and empty receipt set, then matching-token one write and one stored receipt
assertion_analysis.fails_when: Restoring the original WHERE entry.claim_token IS NULL OR shortcut stores the tokenless entry and fails the first assertion; the matching-owner arm proves the instrument can see a receipt.

assertion_analysis.assertions: wrong-token, wrong-sequence and absent-sequence zero writes and no receipts
assertion_analysis.fails_when: A writer that admits these entries through the modeled shortcut fails, but deleting only the emitted token/sequence comparisons does not fail because the double independently enforces them; this limitation is a non-blocking finding.

assertion_analysis.assertions: tokenless released denied, capped extracted denied, capped failed admitted and stored outcome capped
assertion_analysis.fails_when: Restoring the old tokenless shortcut or removing the failed-status predicate contradicts the zero-write assertions; removing the capped or unclaimed branches blocks the positive control; wrong capped sequences are not modeled or tested.

assertion_analysis.assertions: persisted source ID; receipt singleton; mapped outcome; explicit metadata precedence and source metadata fallback; reason
assertion_analysis.fails_when: Removing the worker metadata fields changes explicit run/batch to distinct source-run/source-batch and fails; removing the Cypher coalesce expressions loses fallback values and fails; changing outcome/reason or consuming no source contradicts the stored receipt or returned source.

assertion_analysis.assertions: no persisted winners; candidate named in stored error; grammar and fiber_bundle detail or unit conflict and both units; claim released
assertion_analysis.fails_when: Restoring the generic refusal string loses grammar/unit text; dropping the writer diagnostic map or forwarding loses details; persisting the refused winner or retaining its claim fails the independent graph-state assertions.

assertion_analysis.assertions: exact captured outcome dictionary includes run_id=None and batch_key=None
assertion_analysis.fails_when: Removing either metadata key from the production outcome or giving an absent-input field a non-null default fails equality; input contains neither key, so the literal None expectations are independent of the captured output.

assertion_independence: No added assertion compares a supplied object to the same object returned as expected output; run/batch constants intentionally test propagation into independently stored receipts, with distinct source fallback values.
